text:
Rohit: Quick announcement — were opening two small Dedicated V100F retrofit pools in Barcelona (BCN) and Manila (MNL) today for low-latency edge inference trials. Short reservation window + new cold-reserve policy. Docs/links below. :globe_with_meridians:
deploy-bot: [deploy] created pool v100f-barcelona (size=9) and pool v100f-manila (size=7)  rollout=rl-2026-v100f-01
Kait: Nice. What do you mean by cold-reserve?
Rohit: Cold-reserve = were pre-warming a small standby set of GPUs to reduce first-request latency for on-demand customers. These are separate from normal reserved slots and have a different billing model (lower baseline charge + per-activation GPU-hours). Customers will see activation events in billing and can pre-warm via API.
ops-sales: Heads-up to sales: disclose cold-reserve activation charge and the shorter reservation window (max 72h) when quoting. Use PRICING code V100F-COLD in quotes.
Kait: Are these preemptible? Can we evict pre-warm activations?
Rohit: Cold-reserves are reclaimable with a 1h notice for higher-priority reserved usage. Active sessions are given 15min drain + optional checkpoint webhook. Were adding an auto-fallback route to nearest L-class pool if activation is reclaimed.
infra-team: Tagging policy: add tags: region, project, prewarm=true/false (e.g., project=voice-region region=bcn prewarm=true). Untagged prewarm holds will be auto-cancelled after 6h.
ops-oncall: Monitoring rule created: pool.v100f-*-prewarm-activations > 5 for 10m -> page #ops-oncall and notify #infra if error_rate > 3%.
Rohit: SLA note  Dedicated uptime SLA unchanged. Cold-reserve activations have a different availability expectation and are documented as "best-effort activation" in the customer doc.
Kait: Can we get a short CLI snippet for teams?
Rohit: CLI snippet below: 
```
# list v100f pools in Barcelona
redwoodctl pools list --filter "v100f" --region bcn
# create a cold-reserve prewarm hold for 2 GPUs for 24h
redwoodctl reservations create --pool v100f-barcelona --count 2 --duration 24h --tags project=my-app,prewarm=true
# activate a prewarm hold (start billing GPU-hours)
redwoodctl reservations activate --id <reservation-id>
# cancel a hold
redwoodctl reservations cancel --id <reservation-id>
```
ops-sales: Finance note  cold-reserve activation hours are billed at 0.6x the standard GPU-hour rate during the trial period. Invoice line item = V100F-COLD-ACT.
infra-team: Operational safety  enabling a 30m config lock during the initial rollout; nightly cleanup removes stale prewarm holds older than 6h.
ops-oncall: If initial-request P95 latency for v100f pools increases > 25% for 3 intervals, routing fallback to L-class will trigger automatically and infra will be paged.
Kait: Wheres the customer doc?
Rohit: https://redwood.ai/docs/dedicated/v100f-cold-reserve-trial  includes reservation flow, webhook payload example for 1h reclaim notice, pricing, and migration checklist. Dashboard link will be added by EOD.
ops-sales: Please label any customer trial reservations with sales case ID to help billing reconciliation.
Rohit: Thanks all  ping #ops-oncall for anything urgent. :pray:
